# ClipSignal

> A Windows Codex suite for foreign-trade content production and evidence-based buyer prospecting. It pairs reference analysis, shot briefs, editable Jianying drafts and source records with browser-based company verification, authorized outreach and sales handoff.

Start with the one-prompt installation and preflight. Read the workflow and testing records together for module prerequisites, verified results and goals for on-site validation. The first case is Zhejiang Kooying's commercial-vehicle brake components at Automechanika Shanghai.

- [Agent Research and evidence map](docs/research.md)
